seo.description: Visit the Kasbah of Selouane near Nador: Alaouite-era fortification and practical visit tips.

name: Kasbah of Selouane
hero_subtitle: A 17th-century Alaouite fortification inland from Nador — a short heritage hop from the lagoon city.

overview.title: Stone history off the lagoon
overview.p1: The Kasbah of Selouane dates to the Alaouite period under Moulay Ismaïl and stands inland from Nador’s lagoon shore — a reminder that the region’s story is not only coastal.
overview.p2: Expect a fortification visit rather than a full museum day. Access details can vary; check locally before you go.
overview.p3: Pair it with a lagoon afternoon so the day balances heritage and water.

food.title: Food near the Kasbah of Selouane
food.p1: Selouane is a short inland hop — eat simple local food if a café is open, or plan main meals in Nador before and after the visit.
food.li1: Check whether a local café is open before counting on lunch on site.
food.li2: Carry water for the visit itself.
food.li3: Return to Nador for seafood or a fuller dinner.
food.li4: A mid-morning visit leaves the afternoon free for the corniche.
food.li5: Do not expect a tourist restaurant strip around the kasbah.
food.p2: Treat this as a heritage stop with meals anchored in Nador.
